paite: Huchi in Jerusalem khua tung ding a akisak ua, Olive tang a Bethphage leh Bethani kho kiang atun un, anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah,
heading: Jerusalem A Jesu Lutna / (Mat 21.1-11; Luk 19.28-40; Joh 12.12-19)
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

paite: "Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla; na lut tung un sabiltungnou kikhih, kuamah tuan ngeilouhna, na mu ding ua; phel unla, hon kai un.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in, huai bangziak a hih ahon chih uleh, Toupa'n adeih a ahi; hiai ah ahon koihsak nawn pah na ding, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

paite: Huan ahohta ua, kongzing ah kongkhak polam a sabiltungnou kikhih ava mu ua; huai aphelta uhi.
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

paite: Huai a dingh kuate hiam in, akiang uah, "Sabiltungnou bangziak a phel?" achi uhi.
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

paite: Amau Jesu gen bangtak in akiang uah agen ua; huchi in aphalta uhi.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

paite: Huan Jesu kiang ah sabiltungnou ahon kai ua, atung ah apuante uh aphah ua; atung ah atuangta hi.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

paite: Mi tampi in lampi ah apuan uh aphah ua; midang in leng gam a sawlnah sat in aphah uhi.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

paite: Amalam a paite leh anunglam a hon zuite'n: "Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha!
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

paite: Gam hong tung ding, i Pa David lalgam ahampha! Tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a tempul ah ava lut a; bangkim a-et velvel khit in nitaklam leng ahong hita a, apawt a, sawm-le-nihte toh Bethani ah apaita uhi.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

paite: Azing in Bethani a kipan apawt nung in agil ahong kialta hi.
heading: Theipi Kung Hut / (Mat 21.18-19)
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

paite: Theipi kung nah nei gamlapi ah amu a, agah ka muh khakleh chi in ava zuan hi; ava tun in anah kia lou ngal bangmah amuta kei a; theipi gah hun ahi kei him hi.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n sing ahoupih a, "Tuban tangtawn in nang a pan kuamah in gah ne nawnta kei hen," achi hi. Anungzuite'n huai aza uhi.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua atung ua, tempul ah ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite adelhkhia a, dangka kheng mite dohkante leh vakhu zuak mite tutphah asawnpuksak hi.
heading: Jerusalem Tempul Hihsianna / (Mat 21.12-17; Luk 19.45-48; Joh 2.13-22)
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

paite: Tempul a mite'n van alut paisuakpih uh aphalta kei hi.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

paite: Huan amaute sinsak in akiang uah, "Ka inn nam chih a ding in thumna inn achi ding uh, chih gelh ahi kei a hia? Nou suamhatte khuk in na bawl ua," achi hi.
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

paite: Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n huai aza ua, amah hihmanthat theihna ding azongta uhi; mipi tengteng in athuhilh lamdang asak ziak un amah alau uhi.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in khopi a kipan apawtkhia uhi.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

paite: Huan zingsang a apai kawm un huai theipi kung azung tanpha vuai khin in amuta uhi.
heading: Theipi Kung A Pan Sinlai / (Mat 21.20-22)
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

paite: Huchi in Peter in theikhia in akiang ah, "Heutupa, en dih; theipi kung hamsiat na loh ana vuai khin vekta," achi hi.
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian gingta un.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh in hiai tang kiang ah, na kisuan inla, tuipi ah na kipailut in chi a, alungtang a ginglel lou a agen atung ngeingei ding chih gingta peuhmah in agen bangbang amu ding uhi.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bangkim thum a na nget peuhmah uh musa in kiging unla huchi in na mu ding uh.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

paite: Thum a na din peuhmah chiang un kua tung ah leng thubuai banghiam na neih uleh ngaidam un; na Pa uh van a om in leng na tatlekna uh ahon ngaihdam theihna ding in.
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

paite: Himahleh na ngaihdam kei uleh, na Pa uh van a om in na tatleknate uh ahon ngaidam sam kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua atung nawn ua; tempul a avak lai in siampu liante, laigelhmite leh upate akiang ah ahong pai ua,
heading: Jesu Thuneihna Ginlelhna / (Mat 21.23-27; Luk 20.1-8)
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

paite: akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Hiai thilte hih ding in kua'n ahia nang thu hon piak?" achi uhi.
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding, hon dawng le uchin, huchi in kua thu in ahia hiai thil ka hih chih ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: "Johan Baptisma van a kipan hia; mihing a kipan? Hon dawng un," achi hi.
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

paite: Huan akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, Bang achia athu gingta lou na hi ua, ahon chi dia;
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

paite: himahleh mihing a kipan chi leng mipi akihta ua; mi tengteng in Johan zawlnei taktak in abawl chiat uhi."
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

paite: Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih, ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
